**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Equip item '....'

**Game Environment**
Please provide details about the game environment, either by crash report/logs or by detailing it below. If possible, try to reproduce the issue without any mods unrelated to the issue before reporting. Otherwise, include a complete list of mods or the name and version of the modpack you're using. A crash report always contains a full modlist. You can manually cause the game to crash by holding F3 + C for 10 seconds and then upload the file by dragging it here.
